_comment: CRON-COMPLETIONIST-68: Jue Ming Valley Abyss (决明谷深渊) — the deepest, rarest cave layer beneath the valley. MOD-ORIGINAL: the novel does not explicitly describe an 'abyss' beneath the valley; this biome represents the deepest mythic layer where the oldest sealed beasts and ancient restrictions reside (canonically the valley has 'sealed beasts, hidden inheritance' per the blueprint). CANON ANCHOR: Wang Lin's body was destroyed at the surface valley, NOT in the abyss — the bead (天逆珠) is found in the 域外战场 (Extraterrestrial Battlefield), NOT here. Do NOT place the bead in this biome. CLIMATE: coldest (cave deepest), no precipitation, black sky/fog. SPAWNERS: heaviest monsters (the abyss is most dangerous), rarest creatures. FEATURES: rarest spirit veins (concealed + dead, representing the deep ancient essence); demon_corpse_mushroom_ancient (oldest corpses); NO surface vegetation. CARVERS: deepest cave networks only. Referenced by spirit_bat_spawns.json biome modifier. This biome exists at depth [-1.0, -0.95] in the multi_noise biome source — only the very deepest caves near the valley center.
